title: Train for Many, Update with One: Improving Multi-Sample Reasoning via Fenchel-Bregman Posterior Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17735v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-sample reasoning measures candidate coverage, the probability that at least one of $K$ candidates is correct. However, minimizing the average loss of individual attempts does not directly optimize candidate coverage. We therefore formulate finite-$K$ posterior learning, which trains a distribution over solver parameters to reduce the probability that all $K$ independently generated candidates fail. To optimize this objective efficiently, we propose a Fenchel-Bregman (FB) approach that requires only one posterior draw per update, rather than the $K$ used by direct Monte Carlo optimization. FB first uses an exact Fenchel reformulation to separate problem-specific weights from the posterior update, enabling one-draw posterior updates. It then applies a closed-form Bregman update to track these weights through an exponential running average of observed failures, reusing the same draw. translated_title: 为多样本训练，单次采样更新：通过Fenchel-Bregman后验学习改进多样本推理
translated_abstract: 多样本推理衡量的是候选覆盖率，即K个候选中至少有一个正确的概率。然而，最小化单次尝试的平均损失并不能直接优化候选覆盖率。为此，我们提出了有限K后验学习，即训练一个定义在求解器参数上的分布，以降低所有K个独立生成的候选全部失败的概率。为了高效优化这一目标，我们提出了一种Fenchel-Bregman（FB）方法，每次更新只需进行一次后验采样，而直接蒙特卡洛优化则需要K次采样。FB首先利用精确的Fenchel重整化，将问题特定的权重与后验更新分离，从而实现单次采样的后验更新；随后应用闭式Bregman更新，通过观测失败次数的指数滑动平均来追踪这些权重，并复用同一次采样。我们用变分优化器IVON对FB方法进行了实例化。
tldr: 提出Fenchel-Bregman后验学习方法，通过Fenchel重整化与闭式Bregman更新，每次仅需一次后验采样即可优化多样本推理的候选覆盖率，大幅降低了直接蒙特卡洛方法所需K次采样的计算成本。
en_tdlr: A Fenchel-Bregman posterior learning approach that optimizes candidate coverage in multi-sample reasoning using only one posterior draw per update, drastically reducing the K-draw computational cost of direct Monte Carlo optimization.
